USED BY:        Service Demand subroutine of the National Energy Modeling System												
                (NEMS) Commercial Demand Module (CDM)												
												
DEFINITION:     Energy Use Intensities (EUI)												
												
                Energy consumed per unit floorspace												
												
UNITS:          thousand Btu consumed/sqft												
												
DIMENSION:      Census division, building type, end-use service, fuel type												
												
SPECIAL CONSTRAINTS:    Non-negative values												
												
ORGANIZATION OF DATA:												
												
                Data starts on row 101 of this file as per CDM convention.												
												
                Each block of 11 triplets of lines corresponds to a Census Division, in												
                the customary order of:  New England, Middle Atlantic, East North												
                Central, West North Central, South Atlantic, East South Central, West												
                South Central, Mountain, and Pacific.												
												
                Each triplet of lines corresponds to a building type, in the customary												
                order of Assembly, Education, Food Sales, Food Service, Health Care,												
                Lodging, Large Office, Small Office, Merc/Service, Warehouse, and Other.												
												
                Each line corresponds to a major fuel, with the first line corresponding												
                to Electricity, the second line corresponding to Natural Gas, and the												
                third line corresponding to Distillate.												
												
SOURCES:												
												
                U.S. Department of Energy, Energy Information Administration
